_comment: web URLs are absolute: replace GATEWAY with the test gateway host before running a11y-gate.sh

exceptions.reason: standalone.html's content-frame iframe: document.activeElement reports it as focused, but Chromium never matches :focus or :focus-visible on an iframe once it holds a loaded document (verified 8.3.8, 24/09/2026 -- el.matches(':focus') is false while document.activeElement === el is true), so no CSS rule on the frame itself can ever paint a ring. A :focus-visible rule is left on .content-frame in case another engine honours it.
